title: Custom Fit Makeup Organizer: 15-Slot Lipstick, Mascara, and Concealer Holder
description:
Bottle organizer and holder with customizable hole size to perfectly hold your makeup, lipstick, mascara, concealer, eyeliner, spray bottles and other cosmetics.  Holds 15 bottles total, 3 staggered tiers. Just measure your bottle diameter and choose a size for a perfect fit. Recommend choosing a hole size 1mm larger then the measured diameter of your bottle for optimal fit.

Customizable to fit any sized cylindrical bottle shape. Great for holding makeup, lipstick, mascara, concealer, eyeliner and cologne & perfume travel sprays. Organize your collection and save space!

To get the size of your bottle, place it on a piece of paper and trace the bottom with a pencil. Then measure the diameter (width) of the trace you just drew on the paper with a ruler down to the nearest millimeter.
